scope: Twelve complete published reader essays and all prerequisite/entry/source/related routes, independently rewritten in five languages.
canonical_source: Published original HTML remains canonical; runtime extraction preserves every paragraph, heading and inline emphasis. No parallel source-article JSON copy.
source_reading: Lead and all three language authors actually read all twelve complete Chinese essays plus original index and source/reader routes before drafting.

fr.additional_metadata_reading: lead editor read all series/UI/context/entry fields, twelve titles/decks/kickers and common source note

boundaries: Old quoted claims are objects of examination: do not silently replace them with newer formulations.
Concession of capacity enacted by an act is not adoption of non-doubt as an own-law premise; neither may be merged with normative status.
Own-law cost is not the consequences for a friend/team, public price or cross-person ranking; paying it does not settle harm.
A rule-out judgment requires independently verified necessary condition and nonfulfilment; risk traces are direction reports, not verdicts.
Diagnosis concerns an operation by moment/domain, not an entire person, inner motive or license to dispose of them.
A review channel may remain open without infinite personal availability.
Unproved bridges, candidate independence constructions, explicit limits of the argument against candid domination and external-institution legitimacy remain open, not editorially completed.
integration: Keep all 24 original EN/ZH raw reading bodies, 13 complete primary main areas and 13 offline Hant dictionaries; preserve original lack of primary JSON-LD rather than fabricating historical metadata. Add five native indexes, all twelve essays each and original 01/05/11 entry choices; verify existing native Foundations/First Critique/Action reader routes.
deployment: One local commit after full editorial and technical/browser acceptance; no push.
